candidate_close.description: True from close_onset step through close_end step. Computed from event_close_onset and event_end_step. Forward-filled as a segment mask.

valid_retention.description: True when candidate_close AND retention_active AND grasp_support AND NOT release_imminent.

critical_retention_window.description: A contiguous segment of valid_retention=True steps that has duration >= min_critical_duration (default 10 steps) and contains at least one event_support step.

false_trigger_veto.description: True when candidate_close is true but the close window is NOT a valid retention window. Categories: close_without_support, support_without_retention, premature_release, unstable_multi_close, post_retention_release.

release_imminent_label.description: Directly from Teacher record release_imminent field.

event_valid_mask.description: True when Teacher evidence is valid AND retention_unknown_mask is false. Steps where Teacher cannot determine labels are masked.

hard_negative_category.description: For each close candidate window, assign one of: VALID_RETENTION, CLOSE_WITHOUT_SUPPORT, SUPPORT_WITHOUT_RETENTION, PREMATURE_RELEASE, UNSTABLE_MULTI_CLOSE, POST_RETENTION_RELEASE, NO_CLOSE_SIMPLE_NEGATIVE, UNKNOWN_OR_AMBIGUOUS.

candidate_window_rules.end_detection: event_end_step from corresponding close event, or first step where all of [candidate_close, grasp_support, retention_active] are false for >= sustain_gap steps

close_baseline_label_comparison.description: For diagnostic audit only. The close baseline (emit whenever candidate_close=True) is compared against each Teacher V2 label to measure degeneracy.
close_baseline_label_comparison.degeneracy_threshold: If close baseline achieves >= 0.95 recall on critical_retention_window, the label may be too close to close heuristic.
